0.name: block
0.value:
pc_regions holds a map of named regions in the volume, and sums the cloud into each of them, every frame.

A region is any set of voxels you choose to name: 'the chair', 'stage left', 'where she stood'. pc_voxel's boxes divide the room into a regular lattice;
regions are whatever shapes the room actually has. Put pc_regions after pc_voxel.

WHAT COMES OUT:
'region values' is one number per region, indexed by region number: the sum of the weights of the points inside it (their count, for a cloud without weights). From pc_voxel that is how much of the cloud is in each region. A region number is a slot and is never renumbered - emptying region 2 leaves region 3 as region 3, so whatever you mapped to it keeps working.

'cloud' passes the frame on with the regions attached, in the same form pc_voxel's boxes take, so pc_cluster_filter steadies region values exactly as it does box values, and mgl_regions draws them. 'region cells' sends the cells of the region you are working on (or all of them - 'show', option) as a plain cloud whenever the map changes. 'info' describes the current region.

THE MAP'S VOLUME:
The map takes its grid from the first frame - the volume and the voxel size carried in from pc_voxel or pc_crop - and keeps it from then on, for as long as any region holds a cell. Points are looked up by position, so changing pc_voxel's voxel size or the crop later does not wipe the map. The options show the volume actually in use. 'clear all' lets it follow the cloud again.

MAKING REGIONS:
The node reads top to bottom in the order the work goes, and every button acts on the CURRENT region at once. 'undo' takes back the last change.

'region' and 'name' choose the region you are working on and name it. An unused number is a new region. 'pick region' makes current whichever region holds most of the cloud: stand in it and press. 'clear region' empties the current one; 'clear all' removes every region.

CAPTURE INTO REGION takes the cells under a cloud - the one on 'capture cloud in', or the live cloud when nothing is connected there: 'where I am standing now'. 'add' puts them in the region, 'remove' takes them out, 'replace' makes them the whole of it. When a cell already belongs to another region, 'assign mode' (option) decides: 'steal' it, or 'yield' to the other region.

Wire pc_accumulate into 'capture cloud in' to capture everywhere someone has been over a stretch of time, rather than one moment.

EDIT REGION reshapes the region itself, by 'steps' cells:
  grow / shrink  out or in by 'steps' cells.
  fill           close gaps up to 'steps' wide, then fill what that encloses.
                 Mends a speckled capture.
  hull           the convex hull. A captured body is only the shell the
                 camera saw; hull makes it solid.
  box            the bounding box.
  snap           the pc_voxel boxes at least 'snap coverage' (option) full of
                 the region, whole.
  cut            remove the pieces of the region (its separate blobs - the
                 count is shown under the name) that the capture cloud
                 touches: stand in the stray bit and press.

VOXELS OR BOXES:
'work in' sets the grain all of that works in. 'voxels' is the map's own cells. 'boxes' is pc_voxel's boxes (set 'boxes (x,y,z)' there): a capture takes every box the cloud touches, whole; an edit treats the region as the boxes it touches and gives it back as those boxes; 'steps' counts boxes. 'min points' (option) is how many points must land in a cell or box for it to count as cloud - in boxes it stops a box that a stray voxel grazes from being taken.

BUILDING ONE PIECE AT A TIME:
'absorb' (option, from region 'absorb from', or the message 'absorb n') moves every cell of another region into the current one. To sculpt a piece before it joins a region that already has cells - where a hull would bridge the two - capture it into a spare number, shape it there, and absorb it.

CLICKING IN THE PICTURE:
mgl_regions draws the map and lets you author it with the mouse. Wire mgl_context's 'ui' to it, its 'picked region' to 'region' and its 'click command' to 'command', as here. A click makes the clicked region current; a shift-click adds the clicked piece of the cloud to the current region; a ctrl-click cuts the clicked piece out of whichever region it hit; an alt-click makes the clicked piece a new region.

MESSAGES:
Every button is also a message of the same name, accepted on any input - 'command' is there to give a pedal, OSC or a button_set somewhere to plug in. Some actions are messages only:

  left / right / down / up / back / forward
                 move the region by 'steps' cells along -x / +x, -y / +y,
                 -z / +z. pc_region_moves is a ready-made set of these.
  move x y z     move by whole cells.
  extend x|y|z [+|-]
                 stretch the region to the edge of the volume along an axis,
                 both ways or one: 'extend y' makes a footprint a pillar.
  add / replace / new / cut / pick  ox oy oz dx dy dz
                 the action aimed along a ray (an origin and a direction, in
                 metres): it takes only the piece the ray first meets. This
                 is what mgl_regions' clicks send.
  absorb n       as above.

KEEPING THE MAP:
The map is saved in the patch. It can also live in an .npz file of its own:
'save' and 'load' (options). With 'path' set, saving the patch rewrites that file too, and a patch with no map in it loads the file.

SYNTAX:
pc_regions

EXAMPLE:
pc_regions

INPUTS and PARAMETERS:

point cloud:
The live cloud, usually from pc_voxel. Each one is summed into the regions.

capture cloud in:
The cloud that capture, 'pick region' and 'cut' read. With nothing connected they read the live cloud.

region / name:
The current region's number and name.

work in:
voxels or boxes.

steps:
How far grow, shrink, fill and the moves go. Default 1.

command:
Messages, as above.

assign mode / snap coverage / min points / absorb from / absorb / show / surface only / save / load / path / voxel size (cm) / min (x,y,z) / max (x,y,z) (options):
As above. 'show' and 'surface only' choose what 'region cells' sends; the volume options are only used before the map has a grid.

OUTPUTS:

cloud:
The input frame with the regions attached, for mgl_regions or pc_cluster_filter.

region values:
The sum in each region, indexed by region number.

region cells:
The current region's cells (or all regions') as a cloud of cell centres.

info:
The current region's name, size, and how many regions there are.

RELATED:
pc_voxel comes before it. mgl_regions draws the map and takes clicks. pc_accumulate makes a capture cloud of where someone has been. pc_region_moves moves regions about. pc_cluster_filter steadies the values.
